title: Pier Root
oneLinePitch: An arcade game where a player uses root and petal actions to fight space forces on a pier under rain, unlocking mystery progression.

steps.question: How long should one run last before it feels complete?
steps.impact: Sets encounter density, map size, and upgrade pacing.

steps.question: Which enemy types define the core pressure of the run?
steps.impact: Shapes encounter design, telegraphing, and fail-state tension.

steps.question: Which verbs should the player use constantly?
steps.impact: Locks the feel of traversal, combat rhythm, and input complexity.

steps.question: What long-term objective should each run feed into?
steps.impact: Determines meta progression rewards and run-to-run continuity.

steps.question: Which environmental anchors keep the world readable and memorable?
steps.impact: Guides art direction, hazard framing, and level landmarks.

explorationLoops.prompt: What happens if cliff traversal meets pile play under swarm pressure?
explorationLoops.injection: Resolve the loop by rewarding conquest instead of raw score.
explorationLoops.decision: Keep pile as a repeatable skill test, escalate with swarm, and use conquest as the reason to push deeper.

explorationLoops.prompt: What happens if rain traversal meets dash play under sentry pressure?
explorationLoops.injection: Resolve the loop by rewarding unlock instead of raw score.
explorationLoops.decision: Keep dash as a repeatable skill test, escalate with sentry, and use unlock as the reason to push deeper.

explorationLoops.prompt: What happens if top traversal meets message play under beacon pressure?
explorationLoops.injection: Resolve the loop by rewarding spread instead of raw score.
explorationLoops.decision: Keep message as a repeatable skill test, escalate with beacon, and use spread as the reason to push deeper.

explorationLoops.prompt: Create an atmospheric arcade game where player actions interact with a rain-soaked pier environment.
explorationLoops.injection: Integrate the flame mechanic and enemy 'Beacon' to trigger unique movement patterns against space forces.
explorationLoops.decision: Develop a progression system that unlocks mysteries as the player ascends above the pier.

finalSpec.playerFantasy: A guardian defending their home against chaotic space entities while navigating hostile terrain.

world.setting: A fusion of pier architecture, rainy skies, and den-like structures inhabited by space monsters.
world.visualDirection: High contrast between the dark water and neon lights of the pier amidst stormy backgrounds.

coreLoop: Root action to push enemies back or plant petals to create temporary barriers against advancing foes.
Player moves across compact expressive levels, switching between movement methods to survive patrolling by space guards.
Enemies spawn randomly along rain-slicked paths; surviving the run unlocks new abilities and mystery story elements.

enemyArchetypes.name: guard
enemyArchetypes.behavior: Pushes the player off safe routes and punishes hesitation.

enemyArchetypes.name: command
enemyArchetypes.behavior: Locks down key spaces and forces rerouting.

enemyArchetypes.name: commander
enemyArchetypes.behavior: Breaks steady rhythm and spikes reaction difficulty.

progression.runToRunGrowth: Each run converts performance into mystery, unlocked upgrades and route unlocks.

runStructure.opening: Teach root movement and introduce guard reads in a low-risk pier route.
runStructure.midgame: Layer petal interactions, mixed enemy waves, and injection events from the exploration loops.
runStructure.endgame: Force mastery through stacked hazards, elite guard encounters, and a final mystery choice.

enemyCompositions: Keep pile as a repeatable skill test, escalate with swarm, and use conquest as the reason to push deeper.
Keep dash as a repeatable skill test, escalate with sentry, and use unlock as the reason to push deeper.
Keep message as a repeatable skill test, escalate with beacon, and use spread as the reason to push deeper.
encounterDesign.difficultyRamp: Initial waves feature basic root mechanics against easy guards; later runs introduce complex petal strategies and faster enemies.

economy.riskReward: High risk of being overwhelmed by space forces, but rewards include discovering hidden mysteries within the pier's layers.

audio.tone: Punchy arcade percussion with environmental accents tied to route danger.
